park-hide-seek.name: Park Hide Seek
park-hide-seek.blurb: All ages! Hide and seek with friends or vs computers in America's National Parks.
park-hide-seek.more:
We feature all the national parks in the USA!
You are either the camper hiding or the ranger trying to find those darn renegade campers!
Choose your drop-in spot. You have some time to hide, then off the rangers run around needing to tag out all the campers!
Find Sasquatch to score BIG!

skate-tech-park.name: Skate Tech Park
skate-tech-park.blurb: Shred America's National Parks on a giant fingerless board!
skate-tech-park.more:
Features all the National Parks in America!
Start out on the rooftop to familiarize yourself with the skating controls.
Then head out to shred out our USA Parks!!

alien-disc-golf.name: Alien Disc Golf
alien-disc-golf.kicker: Aliens use Earth as Disc Golf Course!
alien-disc-golf.blurb: Throw the alien ship across countries and continents. Take into account wind and water!
alien-disc-golf.more:
Uses real NOAA data to influence your game!
Water currents, wind directions!
Careful not to land in the water lest you drift away!

delayed-reaction.name: Delayed Reaction
delayed-reaction.blurb: Listen to the tune to make it through the delay vortex!
delayed-reaction.more:
Music and rhythm based game.
Listen and react!

two-fronts.name: Two Fronts
two-fronts.blurb: Thunder Marines vs Wookas. Control the strategy game & spawn into battles to take command!
two-fronts.more:
The story is based around the story of the Thunder Marines sent in to deal with the bomber bear-like creatures known as Wookas.
Handle the strategy game then choose to take over the space or ground battle.
Do not underestimate the Wooka tribes and their growing threat to the Empire!

git-recon.name: Git Recon
git-recon.blurb: Fight your way through the repo maps to git your commit to merged!
git-recon.more:
Cinematic Third Person shooter played across the real repo's code!
Third Person shooter where you battle across repo levels!

hippo-tycoon.name: Hippo Tycoon
hippo-tycoon.blurb: Pablo's hippos have escaped and the only thing that can satiate then is MORE OIL!

splat-spray.name: Super Spy Splat Shot
splat-spray.blurb: Shoot your way to seeing the room and find the object!
splat-spray.more:
Start in a real, scanned room: it is dark, you light it with the scanner and name what is hiding in it.
Then on to the spy game: 100 things in a dossier, alone or racing friends.

mythic-masters.name: Mythic Masters
mythic-masters.blurb: Bind folklore beasts and fight them in a 1v1 arena.
mythic-masters.more:
Your favorite cryptids need capturing!
Explore the world and their mythos!

qcrm.name: qCRM
qcrm.blurb: Contacts, deals and webhooks in one quick workspace.

qntbr.name: QNTBR
qntbr.blurb: The QNTBR site, signed in with eqosys.

geoboxq.name: GeoBoxQ
geoboxq.blurb: Will it fit in the box? The smallest shipping box for an order, a box in a box included.
geoboxq.more: visually see the box combinations, now with ultimate performance!

splat-rooms.name: Splat Rooms
splat-rooms.blurb: The room goes dark and you get a list. Find every object in a photoreal scanned room.
splat-rooms.more:
Quick hunt drops you in a random room.
Or flick through the room browser: every object in every room has a label and a box you can click.

excalibrawl.name: Excalibrawl
excalibrawl.blurb: Every hour two AI models fight on one canvas and a third one judges. Watch live!
excalibrawl.more:
A new fight starts on the hour.
Watch it live, then replay any finished fight.

what-would-fantano-say.name: What Would Fantano Say?
what-would-fantano-say.blurb: Pick a track, drag to your best 15 seconds and get a parody review with a score.
what-would-fantano-say.more:
A joke site, labelled as parody.
Get a score, a verdict, the best and worst bits, and a share button.

fm-daw.name: FM DAW
fm-daw.blurb: Twelve tracks of FM and analog synths, a drum machine, step sequencer and piano roll.
fm-daw.more:
Play it from the computer keyboard or a MIDI keyboard.
The sound engine is in Rust and in TypeScript: switch between them while the groove plays.

motion-midi.name: Motion MIDI
motion-midi.blurb: Render a song with a synth written in Rust and in TypeScript, then hear them match.
motion-midi.more:
Hit Render and play.
Compare engines to see what the Rust build buys.

brianfloresblitzing.name: One Team in 32
brianfloresblitzing.blurb: How far can one team move the whole league's blitz rate? Slide it and see.
brianfloresblitzing.more:
All 32 teams' 2026 blitz rates.
A calculator for the gap one team needs to move the league average.

codesplitter.name: codeSplitter
codesplitter.blurb: A code host where every line is its own record and many agents edit at once.
codesplitter.more:
Lines, not files, are the unit.
Three agents can edit one file at the same moment and never step on each other.
Real git, on Cloudflare.

playground.name: Playground
playground.blurb: Every app in one place, with a way to try it: play, download or read the source.

hello-world.name: Hello World
hello-world.blurb: The smallest Rusty Buns app: one page, static assets only.

at-lens.name: AT Lens
at-lens.blurb: Type a handle and watch the AT Protocol find its records step by step.
at-lens.more:
From handle to DID to data server to typed records.
Then watch the account live on the public firehose.

auto-rig.name: Auto Rig
auto-rig.blurb: Drop in a 3D model and get a skeleton, skin weights and IK you can drag around.
auto-rig.more:
Bring a glTF/GLB or try a built-in sample.
The rigger is in Rust and in TypeScript, with the same answer bit for bit.

meshy-studio.name: Meshy Batch Studio
meshy-studio.blurb: A folder of concept images in, game-ready 3D models out, with your own Meshy key.
meshy-studio.more:
A desktop app: your key stays on your machine.
Each step is priced and confirmed before it runs.

splat-desktop.name: Splat Desktop
splat-desktop.blurb: An open-source 3D Gaussian splat editor as a desktop app that works on your own folders.
splat-desktop.more:
Open a folder of scenes, edit them, keep everything on your disk.
Next up: phone video in, 3D scene out.

tscircuit-desktop.name: tscircuit Desktop
tscircuit-desktop.blurb: Build circuit boards with React, see them live and export fabrication files. Parked for now.
tscircuit-desktop.more:
One desktop file with a Rust engine up to 22x faster.
Parked until tscircuit updates its own dependencies.
